claims.claim: Implemented a versioned, bounded, deterministic, read-only Unified State observation with fixed next-action taxonomy, isolated remote observation, local WAIT/transport handling, historical Admission Failure context, and fail-closed ambiguity.

Implemented lineage-driven REMEDIATION and REPAIR classification using exact correction identities and the existing Correction Preflight boundary, while preserving semantic review requirements for successful correction tips.

Implemented PASS-review classification through existing safe-publication lineage validation and ancestry semantics, producing DONE, PUBLICATION, or bounded integration-required BLOCKED state without mutation.

Added focused regressions and README documentation covering the derived-state boundary, authority separation, fixed actions, fail-closed behavior, and exclusion of Human grammar or Executor recommendations.
